Commentary.Commentary: So, 298 is the target for Sri Lanka. They have batters who can chase it down but the Indians have a few brilliant bowlers at their disposal. Let's see who comes out on top after the second innings is done and dusted. Join us in a while to find out.

He starts by saying that he is happy from his performance and adds that the wicket is good to bat and they managed a few good partnerships. Tells that they will try to take early wickets to put the opposition under pressure.

The Lankan bowling lacked control in the initial stages but they did not allow the Indians to score at brisk pace. Ashian Daniel bowled with control in the middle overs and ended up with a economical spell of 39/1 in 10 overs. However, the others could not trouble the Indians much and could never build pressure. They gave away 88 runs in the death and that might harm them at the end of the game. In the meantime, Indian opener, Yashsavi Jaiswal is caught for a quick chat.

India have put on a very good total on the board, courtesy half tons from Jaiswal, skipper Garg and Jurel. Yashasvi Jaiswal and Divyaansh Saxena combined together and did really well for the opening wicket. Tilak Varma then joined Yashasvi and made sure India did not lose their control from the game. Dhruv Jurel and Siddhesh Veer then added quick 63 unbeaten runs to take India closer to 300.
Yes, he can. Just a single to end the inning. A full ball around off, Jurel looks to drive straight down the ground but fails to time it well. The mid off fielder cuts it off and a run is taken.
Length ball on middle, Veer mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket so only a single. Good over so far from Dilshan. Can he finish it off well.
FOUR! A reverse sweep from Siddhesh now! Dilshan goes for the yorker outside off but ends up bowling a low full toss, Veer switches his hands and reverse sweeps it over point for a boundary.
Full and wide outside off, Veer squeezes it over cover for a couple of runs.
Two dots in a row now! A low full toss on middle, Veer looks to slog it away but misses to get hit on the pads. He'd feel he missed out a scoring opportunity there.
Full and on off, Veer drives it straight to cover. A dot ball.
Dilshan Madushanka to bowl the final over of the innings.
Another slower one, Veer works it towards the leg side and takes a single. 8 from the over, a good one, one can say for the Lankans.
Smart bowling from Pathirana. Veer looks to scoop it over again but Pathirana bowls a slower one around off, Veer is too early in the shot and misses.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and on off, Veer drives it to wide long off for a run.

FOUR! There is no stopping Veer here. He moves to 35 off just 19 balls. 50-stand is up too. Veer is providing the final touch to this Indian innings. A full ball on middle, he moves across the off side and scoops it over the keeper for another boundary.
Half ton for Jurel. A controlled knock from the Indian keeper. A good length ball around off, he taps it towards point and takes a single to get to the landmark.
Matheesha Pathirana to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
Goes for the slower one on middle, Dhruv tucks it towards leg side for a run.
Goes wide outside off, Veer reaches out and squeezes it towards point. The fielder there makes a diving stop so only a run.
SIX! Slammed! Brilliant shot this from Veer! It is full and in the slot of the left-hander. Veer clears his front leg and sends is sailing over mid-wicket for a maximum.
On off, it is defended.
WIDE! Another wide! It is down the leg side. Jurel looks to help it down the leg side but misses.
Full and wide outside off, Veer drives it away from the body. The ball goes towards mid off and the fielder there fumbles. A run taken.
FOUR! Improvisation at its best. A top shot from the left-hander. A fuller ball just outside off, Veer comes towards the off side and then scoops it over the keeper and into the fine leg leg fence.
Amshi de Silva is back on. 5-0-25-1 so far from him.
Outside off, Jurel shoulders arms to this one. 15 runs have come from the over. A very good one for India.
WIDE! Dilshan bowls it wide outside off, Jurel offers no shot to this one.
On a length on off, Veer plays it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over. Short delivery on middle, Veer pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Full delivery on middle, Veer drives it through mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Full delivery on off, Veer drives it through mid off for a boundary.
Full and around off, Dhruv drives it to long off for a run.
Dilshan Madushanka returns. 8-0-46-1 so far from him.
Fires it outside off, Veer looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, Daniel looks to sweep but misses.
Short and around off, it is tapped through mid on for a run.
Short ball on middle, Jurel pulls it towards deep square leg. The fielder. there runs across to his right and stops the ball going into the fence. Two taken
Slightly short and on middle, Veer tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off, turning in, Jurel tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, driven to long off for a single. 5 from the over.
Short and on middle, Veer pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Brilliant running again. The Indians have not missed out on the chance of stealing an extra run. A floated ball on middle, Veer sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and returns for a brace.
Shortish ball around off, Jurel taps it through point for a single.
Pitches it around off, it spins away. Jurel waits for the ball and then guides it to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker ball on middle, Veer looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but nothing form the umpire.
Floated on off and middle, Jurel eases a single through mid on.
Quicker one outside off, Jurel dabs it down to third man and picks a couple of runs.
On off on a fuller length, it is driven to long on for a single.
Flatter and on off, pushed to long on for a single.
Shortish ball on off, it is blocked off the back foot.
Bowling change! Ashian Daniel is back on.
Shortish ball around off, pushed to point. 4 runs and a wicket from the over.
On off, it is pushed to cover.
Full and on middle, driven to long on for a single.
On middle, Veer gets off the mark by pushing this to long on.
Siddhesh Veer is the new man in.

OUT! Stumped! Brilliant bowling form Kamindu. He beats the Indian skipper with his flight. Pitches it on off, Garg comes down the track and looks to go downtown but the ball turns away sharply. Mishara collects the ball and whips the bails off. No need to go the third umpire there.
A couple to start the fresh over now. Full ball around off, Garg skips down the track and lofts it over cover. The fielder in the deep makes a good save.
Bowling change! Kavindu Nadeeshan is back on.
A couple to end the over. Full ball on middle, it is driven to sweeper cover for a couple of runs. 20 runs from the over.
SIX! Brilliant timing! A fuller ball around off, Jurel skips down the track and lofts it over extra cover for a biggie.
FOUR NO BALL! Another poor ball from Paranavithana. It is a high full toss outside off, Jurel thrashes it over the deep mid-wicket fielder who tried to attack the ball. Free Hit coming up.
On middle, Priyam eases a single through mid on.
Full and on off, Jurel drives it well but straight to sweeper cover so only a run.
FOUR! Poor ball and it got the punishment it deserved. Short and on middle, Dhruv goes on the back foot and slams it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full ball outside off, it is driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Brilliant running between the wickets! A full ball on off, Jurel strokes it to long off and before the fielder can get to the ball, a couple of runs taken. Another tight over from Sri Lanka.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.
Length ball outside off, this time Garg taps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full ball on middle, Priyam drives it well but once again finds the cover fielder.
Length ball around off, it is tapped towards point.
Full and on off, Garg drives it well but the cover fielder makes a diving stop.
Powerplay 3 time! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the over.
Another full toss. It is flicked to wide long on for a single.
FIFTY FOR THE SKIPPER! He is leading form the front here. He gets to the milestone by whipping this full toss between deep mid-wicket and long on for a couple.
Loopy full ball on off, Dhruv eases single through mid off.
On middle, it is defended toward covers.
Low full toss outside off, Garg works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Jurel strokes it to sweeper cover for a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! The skipper moves to 47 now. A length ball outside off, Priyam looks to cut away from the body but the ball takes outside edge and goes to third man. The fielder there slides to stop but the ball goes through to the fence.
Low full toss on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.
Full and on off again, Jurel drives it to long off for a single. 200 up for India.
Short and wide outside off, Jurel taps it through cover-point for a single.
Full and on middle, Priyam works it behind square leg for a single.
Dilshan Madushanka is back on. 6-0-37-1 from him so far.
On middle, it is pushed for a run through mid on.
Another fuller ball outside off, Garg drives it through covers and before the long off fielder can run to his right and field the ball, a couple taken.
Full and outside off, Garg drives it well but can't beat the cover fielder.
Flatter ball on middle, Jurel tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball on off, Garg flicks it to long on for a single.
Full and around off, pushed to mid off by Garg.
On middle, Jurel keeps it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shortish and around off, Garg taps it through point for a single.
Flatter and on off, Garg blocks it towards point.
Full and on off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Sharp turn! It pitches on middle and turns away as Jurel comes forward to defend.
Quicker one on middle, Garg forces it to towards mid on. Paranavithana dives full length to his right to make an excellent stop.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and around off and middle, it is pushed through mid on for a single.
Shortish and around off, Jurel blocks it towards point.
Flatter ball on off, Priyam taps it through covers for a single.
Another ball on middle and leg, Priyam tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Jurel punches it to long on and takes a single. Wanted the second but the fielder was quick there.
Full and on off, Jurel drives it through the covers and before the sweeper can come across to field, a couple of runs taken.
On middle, it is turned towards mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short, it is tapped through point for a single.
Full ball on off, Garg strokes it to long off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and leg, it is defended by Jurel.
Loopy ball on middle, driven to long on for a run.
Floated ball around off, Jurel pushes it through mid on for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
Flatter and on the pads, it is worked towards square leg for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, it is worked towards wide mid on for a single.
Low full toss on off, forced to mid on.
Floated fuller ball on off, it is pushed to the left of the bowler for a single.
This time Garg stroeks it past the diving cover fielder to this fuller ball. A single taken.
Another fuller ball, it is driven once again to the man at covers.
Full and on off, driven to covers.
Bowling change! Kavindu Nadeeshan is back on.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket. End of a successful over for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Off the mark and in some style! A full ball outside off, Jurel leans into the shot and drills it through the covers for a boundary.
Around off, it is defended.
Dhruv Jurels is the new man in.

OUT! Stumped! Yes, the foot was in the air, reckons the third umpire. Brilliant work from Mishara. A flighted ball around off, it pitches and then turns away a hint. Verma lunges forward to defend but cannot make any connection. Mishara collects the ball and whips the bails off quickly. Mishara celebrates as he goes towards the bowler. The third umpire has been called for. The third umpire takes his time and then deems it in the favor of Sri Lanka. Varma departs just 4 short of his half ton.

Stumping appeal taken upstairs. Mishara looked really confident there. Looks really close in the replays. The umpire wants to be completely sure about this. Was the foot in the air when the bails were dislodged?
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish ball on off, blocked.
Full and on middle, it is flicked for a run by Verma towards long on.
On middle, it is defended.
Full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle, it is eased for a run through mid on.
Play and a miss! A ball outside off, it keeps low a touch as Verma looks to cut but misses.
Flatter ball on middle, Verma tucks it towards deep square leg and scampers back for a couple.
DRINKS! Navod Paranavithana into the attack post the mini-break.
A couple! Pitches around off and turns in, Garg waits and then tucks it towards deep square leg. The fielder there fumbles and an extra run is taken.
On off, defended off the front foot by Garg.
Full and around off, it is pushed through mid off for a single.
Short and outside off, Tilak slaps it to covers.
Full delivery on middle, Garg drives it through mid on for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Garg nudges it towards square leg.
FOUR! Nicely played! Floated delivery on middle, Varma sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. 50-run stand is up between Tilak Varma and Priyam Garg.
Loopy delivery on middle, Garg flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on off, Garg drives it towards covers.
Tossed up delivery on off, Tilak looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man. The batsmen get three runs.
Short ball on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Garg punches it to mid on.
Slower length ball around off, guided to third man for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to the man at covers.
FOUR! First one for the skipper and it brings 150 up for India. A long hop on middle, Priyam hammers it towards deep mid-wicket and it races to the fence.
On off, it is defended.
Full and on middle, Garg strokes it towards mid on where the fielder makes a diving stop.

Pulled nicely but equally well fielder in the deep. A bouncer on middle, Garg gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg. The fine leg fielder runs across to his left and makes a tumbling stop.
Shortish and outside off, Garg goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
On middle, it is defended.
Another single. Full and on off and middle, Verma forces it to long on for a single.
Flatter ball on off, it is worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Tilak comes forward and strokes it to long on for a single.
Fuller ball on off, pushed towards mid off by Garg for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Length ball on off, it is defended.
Just over! A fuller ball around off, Tilak looks to drive but the ball holds on the surface and hits the upper part of the bat. It lobs over the infield and a couple of runs taken.
FOUR! Full and on the pads again, Tilak easily whips it to the fine leg fence.
On the pads, Priyam nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers.
Matheesha Pathirana is back on. 5-0-27-0 from him so far.
Shortish ball outside off, turning into the right-hander. Garg tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full toss on middle, pushed to long on for a run.
Flatter and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, Garg pushes it to mid on for a single.
Low full toss on middle, it is stroked to long on for a single.
Flicked nicely but only a single. A full ball on middle, Verma flicks it to deep mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Tilak taps it to sweeper cover for a run.
Shortish ball on off, pushed to point.
Full and on the pads, flicked wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder by Garg and another couple of runs for him.
On the pads, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Second wide of the over! It is well over the batsman outside off. Priyam lets it go to the keeper. Called wide.
Brilliant running! A good length ball outside off, Priyam guides it to third man scampers back for a couple.
WIDE! Dilshan starts the over with a ball down the leg side. Priyam looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! Timed superbly! Short ball outside off, Verma rides the bounce nicely and punches it off the back foot and the ball races to the fence.
Slightly short and around off, tapped through point for a run.
A couple now! Flatter ball on middle, Garg works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, driven firmly to the left of the bowler who makes an excellent diving stop.
On the pads, Tilak looks to flick but gets hit on the pads, the ball rolls towards fine leg and a leg bye.
Shortish length which is pitched outside off, it turns into the right-hander, Garg strokes it to deep cover for a single
Priyam is off the mark! A full ball outside off, Garg strokes it towards mid off where the fielder makes a half stop with a dive. A single taken and Garg is off the mark.
Full and on off, driven to mid off by Priyam.
Indian skipper, Priyam Garg, is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Massive blow for the Indians. It is Jaiswal who departs now. A poor shot from him. Length ball outside off, Jaiswal without any feet movement throws his bat at the ball. All he can manage is an outside edge which goes behind. The keeper, Kamil Mishara pouches it comfortably. Jaiswal would feel that a century was on offer but he has missed out a chance.
Length ball on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a run.

A couple from Tilak! A back of a length ball on middle, Verma swivels and helps the ball towards deep square leg. The fine leg fielder runs across to his left and gets to the ball but not before Tilak returns for a brace.
Length ball on off, Tilak works it towards the leg side.
On the pads, Jaiswal works it behind square leg and a couple of runs taken. 11 from the over.
FOUR! Another boundary and it is again coming off the brilliant back foot punch. Short and outside off, Jaiswal goes on the back foot and slaps it through the covers.
Confusion but safe. A flighted ball on the pads, Jaiswal tucks it towards the leg side and thinks of the run. Tilak from the other end responds and then stops. Jaiswal returns back well in time.

FOUR! FIFTY UP FOR JAISAWAL! A fine shot to get to the milestone. A shorter ball around off, Yashasvi rides the bounce and punches it through the covers and the ball races to the fence. 100 up for India with the boundary.
Full and on off, pushed towards mid off.
A quick run! A fuller ball on the pads, Tilak tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Kavindu Nadeeshan is into the attack now.
Full and outside off, Tilak strokes it straight to deep cover for a single. Just 3 from the 20th over.
Length ball on off, it is pushed towards point.
Length ball outside off, pushed to covers by Tilak.
Another shortish ball on middle, Yashasvi tucks it towards square leg and takes a single. Moves to 49 with that run.
Short of a length ball around off, it is blocked towards the leg side and a quick run is taken
Good length ball outside off, Tilak lets it go to the keeper.
Excellent stop! A full ball outside off, Jaiswal drives it towards covers where the fielder dives to his left and makes an excellent stop.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On off, pushed towards point.
A quick run. A fuller ball around off and middle, Tilak tucks it towards the leg side and calls for a quick run.
Flatter and on middle and off, Jaiswal pushes it to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, it is tapped to deep cover for a single.
Full and on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Shortish length around off, Jaiswal blocks it towards point.
Beaten! Good length ball just outside off, Jaiswal pokes at it but the ball moves away a hint to beat the outside edge.
On the pads, Tilak nudges it around the corner and takes a single.
Misfield and an extra run! A short ball outside off, Tilak cuts it to deep point where the fielder cannot pick the ball cleanly and allows a single.
Length ball around off, it is defended off the front foot.
Dilshan Madushanka is back on.

A couple to end the over! A flighted full ball outside off, Jaiswal looks to drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards third man. Before the fielder can get to the ball, a couple of runs for Jaisawal. He moves to 47.
Another shortish ball around off, Tilak forces it to deep cover for a single.
Short of a length ball outside off, tapped to deep point for a single.
Confusion but safe! A full ball on the pads, Yashasvi works it towards short fine leg and thinks for a single. He takes off but his partner is not interested. Jaiswal backtracks well in time.
Flatter one on middle, Jaiswal defends it out.
Full ball on middle, Tilak flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Ashian Daniel is back on. 4-1-13-0 from him so far.
Third dot in a row. A length ball on the stumps, it is blocked.
Shortish ball on off, pushed to point.
Full and on middle, it is worked towards the leg side.
Short of a length ball outside off, it is tapped through covers for a single.
WIDE! Bouncer on middle, it goes way over the ducking batter.
Shortish ball around off, it is pushed to mid off.
Full and on off, driven wide of the mid off fielder for a single.
Bouncer on middle. Tilak ducks under it.
Outside off on a length, Jaiswal waits for the ball and then guides it to third man for a run.
Full toss on middle, it is flicked for a couple of runs towards deep mid-wicket.
WIDE! This time Pathirana sprays on the pads. Jaiswal lets it be. Called wide.
Full and outside off, just inside the tramline. Jaiswal lets it be.
WIDE! Down the leg side. It is called wide.
Full and on middle, Varma strokes it towards mid on where the fielder misfields and a single is taken.
Fuller length ball outside off, Tilak lets it be.

DRINKS! A good hour of play for the Indians. They would've loved to have both their openers out in the middle but de Silva removed Saxena after the 50-run stand. Jaiswal is looking solid out in the middle and he will look to convert the start into a good one and take India towards strong total. Sri Lanka will look to strike quickly again to push the Indians on the back foot. Interesting passage of play awaits.
Short and outside off, it is slapped to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and on off, driven to mid off.
Another ball outside off, Verma shoulders arms again.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot by Tilak.
Full and on middle, stroked to mid on.
Fuller and outside off, Jaiswal lets it go to the keeper.
Shortish ball outside off, it is blocked off the back foot.
Another yorker! This is on middle, Varma does well to flick it behind square leg for a run.
Shortish ball on the body, Jaiswal works it towards short third man for a single.
FOUR! Nicely flicked! Pathirana goes for the yorker but ends up dishing it on the pads, Jaiswal flicks it to fine leg and the ball races to the fence.
Length ball outside off, it is left alone.
Matheesha Pathirana is back on. 3-0-15-0 from him so far.

EDGY RUN! Almsot the second one there. A full ball outside off, Tilak looks to drive away from his body but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards third man. There is a slip in place but it is wide of that fielder. A couple of runs for Tilak and he is off the mark. End of a successful over for the Lankans.
Tilak Verma is in at no. 3.

OUT! Caught! De Silva strikes in his second spell and the opening stand is broken. A back of a length ball on middle, Saxena looks to pull but the ball hits the upper part of the bat and goes to Nipun Dananjaya at mid-wicket. He pouches it easily.
On the pads on a length, it is worked behind square leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Beaten! Good length ball outside off, a hint of away movement there as Jaiswal looks to force it through the off side but gets beaten.
Another full ball outside off, Jaiswal lets it be.
WIDE! He starts with another wide ball. Full and outside off, it is left alone.
Amshi de Silva returns. 2-0-17-0 so far from him.

FOUR! Second one of the over and this time it is due to a very poor effort from the deep cover fielder. A shortish ball outside off, Saxena goes on the back foot and slaps it through covers. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, gets to the ball but is late in bending down. The ball goes through him and into the fence. Another 10-run over for India.
Quicker and outside off, it is stroked to covers.
Full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.

FOUR! Swept away! First boundary off Daniel's bowling. A full ball on off and middle, Jaiswal gets in the position and sweeps it the deep square leg fence. Sweep shot is always the scoring shot for the batters against the spinners. That's exactly what Jaiswal did there.
Flatter ball on off, pushed to the right of the mid off fielder this time for a single.
Full and on off, it is defended towards mid off.
Powerplay 2 begins! Now, two extra fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Shortish ball outside off, it is tapped to third man off the back foot for a run. 10 from the over. At the end of Powerplay 1, India are 54/0.
Length ball on off, it is guided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries now! A fuller ball outside off, Yashasvi comes forward and looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the third man fence. 50 up for India.
FOUR! Quality shot! A fullish ball just outside off, Yashasvi comes across the off pole and whips it to deep mid-wicket fence.
Slash and a miss! A length ball outside off, Jaiswal throws his bat away from the body but does not make any connection.
In the channel outside off, Jaiswal lets it be.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Another very good over from Daniel, just 1 run from it.
Finally a run. It is a low full toss on off, Yashasvi strokes it through mid off for a single.
On off, this time Jaiswal reads the ball well and defends it right in front of his eyes.
Sharp turn again! Bowls it slower through the air and pitches it around off. It turns away after pitching and beats the outside edge.

Fires it outside off, it pitches and then turns away. There is bounce too. Jaiswal stays on the back foot and looks to punch but the ball bounces extra and hits the upper part of the bat and goes towards point.
Shortish ball outside off, it is pushed to covers.
Length ball outside off, Saxena looks to cut away from his body but gets an inside edge onto the pads. 9 from the over, a good one for the Indians.
FOUR! Whipped away! Full and on middle from Dilshan. This is easy picking for Saxena. He whips it off his pads and the ball races to the deep mid-wicket fence.
On off, it is defended towards point with the angled bat.
Length ball on middle, it is defended off the front foot.
Full and outside off, Yashasvi pushes it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Shot of the innings so far! Full and outside off, Yashasvi bends on his front knee and drills it through covers for a boundary. That raced to the fence.
Dilshan Madushanka comes into the attack.
On middle, Saxena keeps it out. A maiden from Daniel.
Shortish ball around off, pushed to point.
Flighted ball around off, it pitches and then turns away sharply. Divyaansh comes forward and drive but misses. The keeper whips the bails off and appeals but nothing from the square leg umpire.
Another loopy ball which is full and just outside off, it is pushed to covers.
Another flighted ball outside off, Saxena comes forward and drives it towards covers.
Flighted fuller ball around off, pushed to covers.
Length ball on middle, it is tucked towards the leg side for nothing.
WIDE! It is not down the leg side but way outside the off pole. Mishra, behind the wicket, does well to dive across to his left and pouch the ball in front of the first slip.
Yorker on middle, Jaiswal does well to bring his bat down in time to keep it out.
Full ball outside off, it is left alone.
Shortish ball on off, Yashasvi defends it off the back foot.
The physio walks out to the middle to check Yashasvi.
Ouch! A bouncer on middle, Yashasvi looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body. He his holding his left arm.
FOUR! Cracking shot! A overpitched ball outside off, Yashasvi leans into the drive and slams it through cover-point for a boundary. 1000 runs for Yashasvi with that boundary in U19 cricket.
Short and around off again, it is pushed to covers. Just 2 runs from Daniel's first.
Slightly shortish ball around off, Yashasvi goes on the back foot and punches it to long off for a single.
Loopy ball around off and middle, another forward defense from Yashasvi.
Another ball around off on a fuller length, Jaiswal comes forward and keeps it out.
On off, Jaisawal pushes it back to the bowler.
Daniel starts with a fuller ball outside off, it is easily stroked towards covers for a single.
First bowling change.  Time for spin. It is Ashian Daniel who comes into the attack.
On middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! 6th wide inside 4 overs. It is a back of a length ball down the leg side. Jaiswal lets it go to the keeper.

Another excellent stop! This time it is Paranavithana who saves a run for his side. Pathirana bowls a low full toss on off, Divyaansh strokes it through covers. The ball was racing to the fence but Paranavithana chases it from covers and makes a sliding save. 3 taken.
Down the leg side now, it is easily flicked to fine leg for a single.

Nicely driven but equally good fieldeing. A full ball just outside off, Saxena leans into the shot and drives it well. However, the mid off fielder dives to his right and makes a half stop. A couple of runs.
Outside off this time, it is left alone.
Full ball around Yashasvi defends it well.
On the stumps line, Saxena defends it towards mid on. Finally, the 9-ball over is finished.
On off, it is pushed for a single to mid off.
Shortish and on off, Saxena taps it towards point for a single.
WIDE! Another wide. De Silva is struggling with his line as he goes down the leg side again.

FOUR! First boundary of the innings. De Silva corrects his line on the off side but it too wide and too full. Saxena drives it through cover-point for a boundary. The point fielder makes a dive to stop the ball but he cannot do so.
WIDE! 2nd wide off the over as de Silva sprays down the leg side.
Another ball on the pads, this time Saxena will take a brace as it goes wide of the deep square leg fielder.
WIDE! Another ball down the leg side. Saxsena lets it be.
Another ball from de Silva on the pads on a good length, Jaiswal flicks it for a run to deep square leg.
Bowls a full ball outside off, Saxena looks to put bat on ball but misses. Good start from Pathirana.
Length ball on the pads, Yashasvi tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
In the channel outside off, it holds it line and goes straight to the keeper. Jaiswal shoulders arms.
Another ball on the off stump line on a good length, Yashasvi once again comes forward and defends it out.
Around off on a length, Jaiswal defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! A back of a length ball on middle and leg, Jaiswal ducks under it but it is way above and called wide by the umpire.
Fuller and on the pads, Saxena flicks it to wide mid on for a run.
Matheesha Pathirana will bowl from the other end. His action is like Lasith Malinga. Interesting to see how he performs in this tournament.
Divyaansh is off the mark too. Another ball on the pads, he flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a run. Calm start from the Indians.
Full toss on the pads, Yashasvi flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On the pads again, Jaiswal easily keeps it out.
WIDE! Sprays down the leg side this time. Yashasvi lets it be. The keeper dives to his right and pouches the ball. Wided.
On the pads on a fuller length, Yashasvi flicks it towards the leg side.
Fullish and around off, Jaiswal comes forward and defends it off the front foot.
De Silva starts with a full ball on middle, Jaiswal flicks it through mid-wicket and before the fielder can chase the ball outside the 30-yard ring, a couple of runs for India and Yashasvi.

We are all set to begin. The Lankan players take their positions on the field. The two Indian openers, Yashasvi Jaiswal and Divyaansh Saxena walk out to the middle as well. Amshi de Silva to start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go.
Both team's players walk out to stand in respect of their respective national anthems.
India captain, Priyam Garg, says that they are happy to bat first. Feels that they have quality all-rounders in the side and they will look to repeat their heroics of 2018 edition of the tournament.

Sri Lanka captain, Nipun Dhananjaya Perera, says that the conditions look good for bowling first up. On asked about the pacers in the side who can use the quick conditions in South Africa, Perera says that they have a good fast bowlers in the side.

Sri Lanka Under 19 (Playing XI) - Kamil Mishara (WK), Navod Paranavithana, Ravindu Rashantha, Thavisha Abhishek, Nipun Dhananjaya Perera (C), Sonal Dinusha, Kavindu Nadeeshan, Ashian Daniel, Amshi Oren, Dilshan Madushanka, Matheesha Anushal.

India Under 19 (Playing XI) : Yashasvi Jaiswal, Divyaansh Saxena, Tilak Varma, Priyam Garg (C), Dhruv Jurel (WK), Siddhesh Veer, Shubhang Hegde, Sushant Mishra, Ravi Bishnoi, Akash Singh , Kartik Tyagi.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bowl first.

The U19 World Champions, India, are ready to begin their campaign in the World Cup as they take on Sri Lanka who too begin their campaign. Indians are once again termed favorites of the tournament and have one of the strongest squad. The likes of Yashasvi Jaiswal, skipper Priyam Garg and Kartik Tyagi will look to make sure they repeat the heroics their side did last time around. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, too have a squad that can trouble any side. Nipun Dananjaya, Kamil Mishara and Navod Paranavithana have a decent experience in their team and would look to begin their campaign with a win against the strong Indian unit.
